# next_url_in_body — server returns next page URL in the response body
# Boots the next_url_in_body scenario, runs one drain (3 pages), and asserts
# the trace and events match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml next_url_in_body
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --

{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"GET","query":{"limit":"<format:string>","since":"<ref cursor.last_timestamp>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 226 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/next_url_in_body/alerts"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":3,"method":"GET","query":{"limit":"<format:string>","since":"<ref cursor.last_timestamp>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 106 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/next_url_in_body/alerts"}
